plan.notes: Source: Corning Community College official CleanCatalog 'Business Administration' degree PDF (Associate in Applied Science, Career, Division of Liberal Arts & Professional Studies; 'SCCC Academic Catalog 2026-2027', corning.cleancatalog.net). The published 'Course Sequencing' guide is transcribed exactly as published: 15+16+15+18 = 64, matching the published 'Total Credits 64'. Prerequisite ordering verified: ENGL 1010 College Composition I (Sem 1) before ENGL 1020 College Composition II (Sem 2); BUSN 1231 Business Law I (Sem 2) before BUSN 1232 Business Law II (Sem 3). Published rules documented: Business Program Electives = any courses with prefixes ACCT, BUSN, ECON, MGMT, or MKTG (1 in Sem 1, 1 in Sem 3, 2 in Sem 4); Economics Elective = ECON 1000, ECON 2001, or ECON 2002; Accounting = ACCT 1000 or ACCT 1030 (ACCT 1000 transcribed); MATH 1110 or Higher; recommended electives: PSYC 1101 for Social Sciences (SUNY Critical Thinking competency), SPCH1080 for Humanities (SUNY Oral Communication competency); the catalog labels the sequencing a planning guide that 'need not be followed exactly or completed in four semesters' - transcribed in published term order per expert standard ('suggested sequence' = usable). Degree classification: AAS = career-oriented ('career program... for students looking for employment following graduation').
